Q: Please state the date and time of the accident for the record. Actually, skip the exact date. Just tell me where it

A: It happened on a two-lane road in Baytown, Texas, near an intersection with a gas station on the corner.
Q: Thank you. Can you describe how the collision occurred?
A: I was driving toward the store when a car coming the other way drifted into my lane. We were going slowly, maybe
walking speed, but we still hit front to front.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was. The airbag did not deploy, but I hit the steering wheel with my arms up.
Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic that evening. They took X-rays and told me my left wrist was fractured. I have a
slpint now and I see a hand specialist next week.
Q: Did you have any injuires before this accident involving that wrist?

Q: Has anyone else been in contact with you aobut the accident?

Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that my car is still at the repair shop and I have been using a rental for work. I want to make sure those costs

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
